description: The Economically Weaker Section (EWS) Residential Project was successfully delivered, covering comprehensive 3D modelling and quantity take-off services, demonstrating the effective application of BIM in government residential and affordable housing projects. An accurate, coordinated 3D BIM model was developed in Autodesk Revit to support efficient project planning, quantity estimation, and material management.
scope: Development of detailed 3D BIM models in Revit
Modelling of major building components and architectural elements
Preparation of material quantity take-offs directly from the Revit model
Extraction of quantities for major construction elements and materials
Organization of model data to support cost estimation and material planning
Review of model information to improve quantity accuracy and consistency
Delivery of structured BIM data to support project planning and execution
highlight: Quantity take-offs extracted directly from the Revit model improved estimation accuracy and reduced manual measurement effort.
